QUOTE: "in which case they are stubs: calloc returns NULL and free does nothing (`platform.c:25-42`)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that under `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_NO_STD_FUNCTIONS` the pointers' initial values are stubs. The calloc stub returns NULL and the free stub does nothing, so nothing is allocated and the defaults don't fall back to the C library.
